title: Club Sandwich Breakfast Bake
subtitle: Layered bread, turkey, bacon, tomato, and eggs baked like a strata.
description: Layers of bread, turkey, bacon, tomato, and egg custard baked like a strata. Slice into squares — club sandwich energy without stacking ten sandwiches by hand.

ingredients.name: mayonnaise
ingredients.notes: light spread on bread, plus lettuce after bake

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Club Sandwich Breakfast Bake in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on. Double-check seasoning after scaling — crew palates run salty after long shifts, so taste the first portion before opening the line.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch Bacon. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 375°F. Grease a deep 9x13 pan. Toast bread until crisp and lightly spread one side of each slice with a thin layer of mayonnaise—this keeps layers distinct after baking.

steps.title: Cook bacon and prep layers
steps.instruction: Cook bacon until crisp, drain, and crumble. Layer half the bread in the pan, top with half the turkey, bacon, tomato, and Swiss. Repeat layers, finishing with bread on top.

steps.title: Pour the custard
steps.instruction: Whisk eggs, milk, salt, and pepper until smooth. Pour slowly over the layered bread, pressing gently so custard reaches the bottom. Rest 10 minutes so bread absorbs liquid.

steps.title: Bake until set
steps.instruction: Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes. Uncover, top with remaining Swiss, and bake 15 more until center reaches 165°F and top is golden brown.

steps.title: Verify safe internal temps
steps.instruction: Spot-check the thickest pieces with an instant-read thermometer — target 165°F. If any piece reads low, return it to heat immediately rather than holding under temp on the line.

steps.title: Hold for call interruptions
steps.instruction: If tones drop mid-service, cover finished food and hold at 140°F in a warm cabinet or 200°F oven — never leave proteins below 140°F for more than 30 minutes cumulative. Note the hold time on the pan with a grease pencil.

steps.title: Portion and open the line
steps.instruction: Portion Club Sandwich Breakfast Bake onto sheet trays or hotel pans for family-style service. Stack plates, forks, and napkins at the end of the line so late-arriving crew can self-serve without bottlenecking the cook.

steps.title: Scale for larger halls
steps.instruction: When cooking for more than 8 firefighters, split into two pans halfway through so the bottom layer does not overcook while the top waits — duplicate mise en place if you double batches.

steps.title: Rest and garnish
steps.instruction: Rest 10 minutes before cutting into squares. Top each portion with shredded lettuce and an extra pinch of bacon if desired. Serve with pickle spears at the line.

steps.title: Final quality check before service
steps.instruction: Walk the line once before opening service for Club Sandwich Breakfast Bake — confirm hotel pans are labeled, backup trays are in the 200°F oven, and thermometers are calibrated. Rookies should ask a senior cook to spot-check the first portion.

stationWorkflow: Toast bread fully crisp—soft bread turns mushy in the custard.
Drain tomato seeds so excess moisture does not pool in the bake.
Cover for the first half of baking so top cheese does not over-brown before center sets.
cleanupNotes: Soak the 9x13 with hot water while warm before egg custard dries on.
Wipe mayo smears from prep boards before they mix with bacon grease.
leftovers: Reheat portions covered at 325°F for 12 minutes; add fresh lettuce after reheating.
Cut leftovers into cubes and pan-fry in butter for crispy breakfast croutons in soup.
